criteria.text: An employee can create, edit while draft, submit and cancel their own leave request with type, start and end date.
A manager can approve or reject the submitted requests of their direct reports; rejecting requires a reason.
Annual leave is deducted from the balance only on approval and given back when an approved request is cancelled.
Every state change is recorded with the actor and the time, and an employee can see the history of their own requests.
Nobody can approve or reject their own request, including a manager or an hr_admin acting on their own leave.
A manager cannot see, approve or reject a request of someone who is not their direct report; the refusal reveals nothing about the request.
A transition outside the allowed state machine (for example approving a cancelled or rejected request) is refused and changes nothing.

owner_answers.answer: Yes, half days are allowed for annual leave and count as 0.5 days.
No delegation in this version: while a manager is away an hr_admin approves their team.
